summary: This paper resolves three fundamental open questions regarding multi-qubit bound magic established by Kitzinger, Eisert, and Kunjwal (arXiv:2611.34872). First, using an exact Motzkin--Burger Balinski tangent-cone completeness proof in Q^{15}, it classifies all 252 extreme rays of PPT_2 (60 dephasing channels in EB_2 and 192 rank-6 channels in the single orbit of the C_5 channel) to prove unconditionally that B_2 = STAB_2 and refine Conjecture 4, showing EB_2 subsetneq PPT_2 subseteq MB_2. Second, using Z[i] Gaussian-sum phase rigidity, it derives a universal odd-k magic witness yielding exact depolarizing robustness thresholds for odd n >= 3, while proving an exact parity dichotomy where even-n flag states collapse into STAB_{2m} via Arf-invariant quadratic stabilizer state mixtures. Third, it constructs an S_n-symmetric, full-rank, non-factorizable PPT channel family G_n^{(delta)} proving irreducible bound magic for all even n >= 4. All mathematical claims are backed by rigorous constructive Lean 4 formalization (18/18 theorems, 0 sorry) and AST-audited zero-float exact rational Python verifications.
